KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #4
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Usalama, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Usalama.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Usalama.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Usalama.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Usalama.

2. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   B. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   C. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.

3. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.

4. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.

5. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. watoto
   B. mato
   C. kitoto
   D. mitoto

6. When practising Maagano, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Maagano.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Maagano.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Maagano.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Maagano.

7. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.

8. When practising upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   C. Copy random text without understanding upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.

9. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. fupi
   B. pana
   C. nene
   D. zito

10. When practising nyakati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to nyakati.
   B. Use insults to “practise” nyakati.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for nyakati.
   D. Copy random text without understanding nyakati.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
